method: Frozen LMCache blake3 rolling full-token chunks, native ObjectKey serialization, proxy SHA256. All observed GETs checked against recorded rendered prompts; no GPU requests.

scenarios.scope: Each positive GET counted once in scenario totals. Lane all totals and phase totals are separate views; never sum both. Same keys may legitimately appear across phases; total-minus-unique counts retransferred payload. Unknown ownership or incomplete/ambiguous phase windows retained explicitly.
